title: Santa Monica Classic Tournament
description:
The World Cup players weren't the only ones leaving it on the field last weekend!

The Santa Monica Classic returned to Historic Belmar Park and across the city with more than 64 teams taking the field for a tournament that continues to inspire young athletes to get outside and enjoy the game.

A special shoutout to Niky's Sports for helping support the next generation of players through equipment donations.

Great job to all of the young Santa Monica soccer stars who brought their energy and passion to the field! 

Soccer spirit is strong in Santa Monica!
transcript_text: [cheering] >> The Santa Monica Classic, a tournament that we created for Santa Monica community. Started off with I think a little bit over 20 teams and it grew over to 64 teams. Bringing back the whole concept of being outdoors is really important. For the kids that are just loving the game and want to be out here and play, we want to provide that environment. >> You feel the vibe before it starts. I want to start it even right now. Some games going on, so I'll see how it's in the kids play here and then, you know, soccer is just everywhere right now. We just try to help out as much as the community with the donation of equipment, obviously with the tournament it makes everyone kind of more excited.
